meta.purpose: Structured review board of suggestions to discover missing information, strengthen decision-making, and improve repository/site governance before implementing changes.

paths.name: Path A · Zero-Cost Immediate Protection & Document Lock (Days 1–7)
paths.goal: Protect privacy, capture expiring tax deadlines, and pin down exact lease/calendar facts before spending a dollar on third-party reports.
paths.risk_profile: Lowest risk — purely protective and information-gathering; zero market signaling.

paths.name: Path B · Full Private Trade-Area, Hazard & Tax Underwriting (Weeks 2–4)
paths.goal: Replace all public blank cells offline with parcel-exact Census tract trends, ZIMAS land floor, FEMA/CGS/OSFM hazard screens, and CPA after-tax math.
paths.estimated_cost: $1,500–$4,500 (CPA + legal abstract; $0 for public GIS/Census API)
paths.risk_profile: Low risk — builds an institutional-grade private dossier before speaking to brokers or tenant.

paths.name: Path C · Dual-Track Market Test vs Confidential Blend-and-Extend (Weeks 4–8)
paths.goal: Price the real short-lease discount via NDA BOVs & lender quotes while testing whether a 10–15 yr lease extension creates immediate risk-adjusted equity.
paths.estimated_cost: $0 for BOVs/debt quotes; legal fee only if LOI/amendment drafted
paths.timeline: 4–6 weeks (strictly AFTER Paths A & B complete)
paths.risk_profile: Moderate — requires strict NDA discipline and prior ROFR check so tenant/market leverage is not leaked.

paths.name: Path D · Website & Repository Governance Improvements (Post-Review)
paths.goal: Improve the live decision site's usability, consolidate the 8+ parallel session trees upon owner approval, and keep automated verification green.
paths.timeline: 1 session after owner selects preferred primary layout
paths.risk_profile: Low — requires explicit owner sign-off before archiving any parallel session's tree.

suggestions.title: Check LA County Decline-in-Value (DIV) eligibility before November 30, 2026
suggestions.why_it_helps: Today is 2026-11-26; the 2026–2027 LA County Assessor DIV filing window closes November 30, 2026. Protects NNN occupancy cost if current assessed value exceeds market value.
suggestions.privacy_rule: File directly on assessor.lacounty.gov; never copy AIN or tax bill into Git.

suggestions.title: Abstract the four critical lease dates & ROFR clause into an offline notice calendar
suggestions.why_it_helps: Eliminates the 5-year ambiguity (2030–2035) and ensures no renewal notice or ROFR trap is accidentally triggered.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Store abstract PDF/sheet in encrypted offline vault only.

suggestions.title: Request 3-year store gross sales statements under the lease reporting clause
suggestions.why_it_helps: Reveals exact rent-to-sales ratio (<7% strong renewal candidate vs >10% closure/rent-cut danger) amid -7.0% Q1 FY2026 system franchise SSS.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Confidential tenant trade secret — offline advisor eyes only.

suggestions.title: Maintain hard air-gap between public GitHub Pages site and private advisor data room
suggestions.why_it_helps: A public Git repo has public commit history forever; keeping all parcel/owner numbers solely as ephemeral browser-calculator inputs guarantees zero PII exposure.

suggestions.title: Register free Census API key & run offline 1-mile / 3-mile multi-vintage ACS + LEHD pull
suggestions.why_it_helps: Replaces 3.81M-person LA City proxies with exact neighborhood income, population, commuter, and poverty trajectories around PARCEL-001.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Publish only anonymized ring aggregates (e.g. '1-Mile Ring') if ever summarized; never publish tract GEOIDs.

suggestions.title: Pull offline ZIMAS zoning, TOC/ED1 tier, lot size, and drive-thru CUP grandfathering status
suggestions.why_it_helps: Establishes the 'vacant-land / alternative-use floor' — if infill land value equals or exceeds NNN value, non-renewal stops being a catastrophe.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Keep APN, street names, and parcel map offline.

suggestions.title: Capture dated FEMA FIRMette, CGS EQ ZApp fault/liquefaction map, CAL FIRE LRA FHSZ & historical directory screen
suggestions.why_it_helps: Replaces regional LA hazard probabilities with parcel-exact regulatory zone determinations and flags any legacy gas-station/dry-cleaner environmental risk early.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Retain map PDFs offline; do not commit coordinates or map crops.

suggestions.title: Have CPA certify adjusted basis, cumulative §1250 depreciation, and Measure ULA jurisdiction
suggestions.why_it_helps: Feeds exact verified inputs into the browser-only calculator so the single After-Tax Sale Proceeds figure is accurate to the dollar.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Enter numbers only in local browser memory; never save to repo.

suggestions.title: Solicit 3 blind/NDA Net-Lease BOVs pricing BOTH 'As-Is Short Fuse' and '15-Yr Renewed'
suggestions.why_it_helps: Empirically measures the short-lease cap-rate penalty in bps rather than relying on rules of thumb.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Require signed confidentiality & non-marketing agreement before sharing address.

suggestions.title: Obtain 2 commercial mortgage broker quotes (bank vs credit union/CMBS) for a buyer of PARCEL-001
suggestions.why_it_helps: Shows exact buyer LTV, amortization cliff, and DSCR constraint at current 4.91% 10Y Treasury benchmark.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Share anonymized lease term & NOI range first.

suggestions.title: Model a 'Blend-and-Extend' proposal before choosing between Sell and Hold
suggestions.why_it_helps: Extending the lease to 12–15 years BEFORE selling can unlock BOTH higher hold security AND top-tier §1031 buyer cap-rate pricing.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Approach tenant only after Gate G-02 & G-03 confirm store strength.

suggestions.title: Pre-underwrite IRC § 1031 exchange replacement buckets alongside a taxable cash sale
suggestions.why_it_helps: Avoids forfeiting 30%–40%+ of equity to federal/CA taxes while eliminating single-tenant and single-fault-basin concentration.
suggestions.privacy_rule: Engage independent bonded QI prior to any sale closing.

suggestions.title: Add encrypted local JSON export/import ('Bring Your Own Private File') to the browser calculator
suggestions.why_it_helps: Lets the owner save private scenario assumptions on an offline USB/encrypted drive and reload them into the browser without any server or localStorage persistence.
suggestions.effort_cost: Low · 60 lines of client-side FileReader/Blob JS
suggestions.privacy_rule: Uses explicit user file download/upload only; zero network or browser storage.

suggestions.title: Consolidate the repository's multiple parallel session trees into one canonical site + archive index
suggestions.why_it_helps: Eight+ parallel session directories (/pages/, /docs/, /workspace/, /audit/, /web/, /ledger-1ebd66da/, /portal-02817d04/) create reviewer fatigue; a single owner-chosen primary tree with an archived-editions drawer simplifies review.
suggestions.effort_cost: Medium · Requires explicit owner approval to archive sibling trees
suggestions.privacy_rule: Preserves git history and all audit logs.

suggestions.title: Standardize vintage & geography badges on every metric across the site
suggestions.why_it_helps: Prevents readers from confusing CA DOF Jan 1, 2026 LA City population (3,806,201) with Census July 1, 2025 V2025 (3,869,089) or Vintage 2024 (3,878,704).

suggestions.title: Align .github/workflows/pages.yml artifact path with repository root or keep disabled
suggestions.why_it_helps: Prevents accidental docs-only GitHub Actions deployments from hiding root and subdirectory trees served by legacy main:/ Pages.
suggestions.effort_cost: Low · 1-line YAML update by workflow owner
suggestions.privacy_rule: Ensure .gitignore continues excluding private/ offline templates.
